metaDescription: Kevin's livestream ties the Cybertruck bomber's anti-gravity warning to the missing scientists and argues McMillan and Leonard belong on the list.
summary: In this livestream, Kevin discusses the missing and dead scientists story and his website WhoKilledTheScientists.com, which he says gathers sourced information without taking a position. He examines the January 1, 2025 Cybertruck explosion outside Trump International Hotel and Matthew Livelsberger's manifesto about anti-gravity and China, and notes similar deaths of Chinese scientists. Kevin argues Los Alamos figures Charles McMillan and Philip Leonard, plus Dallas Ann Hardwick, deserve inclusion. He says the connections are uncertain, and ends with open-ended talk about aliens and his plans for the channel. Kevin repeatedly says he is not a journalist and does not claim to know whether a conspiracy exists.
